about_the_game:
You and I is a comedic, abstract FMV that offers a choose your own adventure style narrative following Mark as he gets lost in the woods with his friend Ace. However, the more time the two spend together, the stranger the two become. Make decisions based on the fractured relationship between Mark and Ace to understand what is really happening.

Navigating through the woods takes between 15 minutes and 1 hour, depending on how deeply you engage with the story and choices. The gameplay is designed for meaningful exploration, and is built around three core systems:

  • Two-Choice Decision System: Allowing for simple branching narratives, and easy ways of back-tracking.

  • Skippable Replays: Already seen a scene? You can skip them to keep the pace flowing without losing context.

  • Plentiful "Endings":  While there are multiple unique paths and route endings to discover, the game ultimately concludes with a single, pivotal decision that determines the final outcome and reflects the full journey you’ve taken.

As the forest path unfolds and reality begins to lose meaning, where will you find yourself? How will you view Ace? How will you view Mark? Who are they together?

If The Truth is Yours, Then The Truth is That Everything is ...

  • Directed by Juan Ablan and Written by Juan Ablan and Kai Hugessen

  • Acting performances by Ved Ballary (Mark) and Kai Hugessen (Ace)

  • Edited by Juan Ablan and Ciara Murray

… You And I

content_descriptors.notes:
Depictions of violence is only implied through audio cues or context. There are topics of Cannibalism, nothing graphic only implied via audio cues. There is implications of murder that isn't ever displayed, but is implied via audio cues and/or context.

Depictions of suicidal behavior. These topics are discussed as one of the characters urges the player to kill them in two separate occasions. 

Depictions of sexual acts are only implied through comedic audio cues or context. There is no graphical display of sexual activity.
